title: Bing AI Performance Report: Copilot's Top Ten Is Not Google's
meta_description: Read on 2 October 2026: Copilot cited my site 1,062 times in 13 days, and its ten most cited pages shared none with Google's ten most clicked.
secondary_keywords: does copilot cite the same pages as google ai overviews

image.takeaway: Copilot’s ten most cited pages and Google’s ten most clicked shared no page over the same 13 days.
